human_authorization.verbatim: Escreva e implemente o proximo passo
human_authorization.scope: Write and execute Passo 1341 to redesign the P1340 lifecycle protocol and, after a valid independent seal, implement and verify the remaining bindings.

observables: stable semantic coordinates external to the runtime ledger
within-cell runtime identity bijections and causal continuity
actual features origin, Func invocation origin, counter occurrence/span role and injective Dict
unknown_policy: Only an explicitly opaque payload after structural, external-coverage and causal checks is Unknown. Missing, malformed, omitted, self-declared coverage or mandatory opacity is Violated/blocking.

root.role: intention, L0, integration and implementation after seal
root.forbidden: edit sealed contract/oracles/attacks or issue own final verdict

contract_author.reads: manifest, step, L0, R6/R6b failures and historical protected contracts; no candidate

oracle_author.reads: manifest, step and contract; no candidate
oracle_author.writes: new p1341-oracle-* and stable expectations only

adversary.reads: manifest, step, contract/oracles and predecessors; no candidate

verifier.reads: protected inputs and outputs; candidate only after seal

stop_conditions: Any normal public API/entity/default/phase/compatibility change is required
Any valid negative mutation survives preseal
Same failure vector survives two revisions
